'''2008 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was the ''Star Wars'' CCG Yavin IV regional championship of 2008, played on Saturday 17 May 2008 at St. Margaret's Church, 141 Hickory Avenue, Bel Air, Maryland, and run by [[Tim Simon]].<ref name="sf-20194-289985">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=289985#p289985 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126102640/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=20194 Internet Archive]</ref> Twenty-one players took part. [[Justin Desai]] beat [[Brad Eier]] in the final to become regional champion, and [[Jan Westergard]] and Eier received the byes into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-20194-302401">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302401#p302401 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125180947/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start40.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20194-302407">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302407#p302407 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125180947/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start40.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' the "art room" in the Primary School building of St. Margaret's Church, 141 Hickory Avenue, Bel Air, Maryland<ref name="sf-20194-289985" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 May 2008<ref name="sf-20194-289985" />
* '''Time:''' announced as "probably in the 11 am range"<ref name="sf-20194-289985" />
* '''Format:''' six games of Swiss, then a match-play final four; no clear sleeves; decklists had to be legible<ref name="sf-20194-289985" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $35<ref name="sf-20194-289985" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tim Simon]]<ref name="sf-20194-289985" /><ref name="sf-20194-302448">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302448#p302448 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Desai]]<ref name="sf-20194-302401" />

== Organization ==

Simon announced the details on 11 April 2008. He wrote that he had organized and run the Yavin IV regional since 2005 and that it was held in the same room as the year before. The Players Committee prize package included two byes to Day 2 of the 2008 World Championship, uncut sheets, glass, booster packs, virtual card sets, EJP/ECC/EPP packs and [[tournament foils]]. Cash was guaranteed for the final four; for 30 players Simon estimated $750 for first, $100 for second and $50 each for third and fourth.<ref name="sf-20194-289985" /> In May he challenged the players to break the attendance record set in 2006.<ref name="sf-20194-300642">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=300642#p300642 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125180854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref>

In the semifinals Eier, playing Light Side first, beat Gemme by 2 and then by 6 as Dark Side. Desai, playing Dark Side first, beat Westergard by 24, and Westergard conceded the match. In the final Eier chose Light Side first and lost by 23, then lost by 13 as Dark Side.<ref name="sf-20194-302448" />

=== Decks ===

According to Mike French, Desai won with Hunt Down and Profit.<ref name="sf-20194-302475">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302475#p302475 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], mikefrench, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> Eier played Hidden Base as his Light Side deck,<ref name="sf-20194-302477">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302477#p302477 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> and wrote that he and Reid Smith played Ralltiir Operations (V) with Occupation.<ref name="sf-20194-302464">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302464#p302464 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> Mike Gemme wrote that Charles Clarkson played Light Side Senate.<ref name="sf-20194-302483">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302483#p302483 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], deck (Mike Gemme), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee scanned the decklists and posted them in a "regional decklists" thread by 26 June 2008.<ref name="sf-20194-302448" /><ref name="sf-20194-310014">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=310014#p310014 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125180725/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start120.html Internet Archive]</ref>
